display_long_description:
Step inside the drawings of contemporary artist Agustin Di Luciano.

An immersive VR art experience where hand-drawn worlds, generative visuals, and original sound become spaces you can enter and explore. Drift through cosmic portals, meet the Forest Goddess, and lose yourself in the evolving landscapes of the Hyperspace series — art made to be felt from the inside.

Di Luciano's work has been exhibited at the MARCO Contemporary Art Museum (Buenos Aires), Faena Art (Miami), the NASDAQ Building (New York), and Decentraland's Metaverse Art Week. His practice — where drawing, nature, and technology meet — comes home to your headset as an ongoing series of immersive pieces.

No goals. No score. Just a few quiet minutes inside a living artwork. Each experience pairs hand-drawn imagery with original sound, moved through at your own pace — seated or standing, gentle on the senses.

New generative pieces are added over time. Become a Studio Patron from inside the app to support the work and unlock every new piece as it's released, along with glimpses from the studio.

Put on your headset, breathe, and step through.
